meta.title: Glapp Alternative — Bring Your GLP-1 History
meta.description: Leaving Glapp? Dozify reads the export, previews every record before writing, and tells you which columns it could not place. Free, nothing uploaded.

strings: Coming from Glapp? Bring the history with you
Export from Glapp, open it in Dozify, and see every record that is about to be written before one of them is. Free, and the file never leaves your phone.
The columns Dozify looks for in a Glapp export
If your dose column is headed “units”

Those rows are listed for you instead of being converted. A unit is a volume on a syringe, and how many milligrams sit in it depends on the concentration of your vial — a number the file does not carry. Writing them into a milligram field would record the wrong dose without anything downstream questioning it, so Dozify shows them and lets you enter the amount your prescriber uses. Why there is no one conversion →
